name: Autodrom Sosnová - 14.11.2026 layout
description: Autodrom Sosnová (Česká Lípa, Czech Republic), the combined 14.11.2026 event layout: main circuit, top slalom section, Sosnová Classic hairpin, Driving Camp handling loops and the start straight. Asphalt outline, road widths and elevation from the Czech state orthophoto (ČÚZK, 12.5 cm/px) and LiDAR (DMR 5G). Race-day setup: barrier tape, water barriers, slalom tyre stacks, start/finish gantry. CSP: grass FX, rain with puddles in the real hollows of the surface. Not affiliated with the circuit owner.
author: Starter kit (ČÚZK Ortofoto + DMR 5G, CC BY 4.0)
